original.title: Mia and the Lost Kite
original.summary: A sweet adventure where Mia discovers teamwork and friendship while finding her kite.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play in the park with her [[slot_toy]].
One sunny day she flew a bright [[slot_color]] kite into the sky.
The kite rose higher and then disappeared behind a fluffy cloud, leaving a trail of wonder.
[[slot_child]] felt a little sad and wondered where the kite had gone.
She asked her friend [[slot_animal]] to help find the missing kite, and they set off together.
They searched the grass, climbed a tall pine tree, and looked under the big oak tree.
From the top they saw the kite tangled in the branches of a friendly maple tree.
They carefully pulled the kite down and untangled it, feeling proud of their teamwork.
[[slot_child]] thanked her friend and they shared a tasty [[slot_snack]] while watching the kite fly.
They laughed and played until the sun set, and the kite flew again, bright and free, just like their friendship.
